## Symptom (live repro, 2026-08-14)
`rebar transition clubby-circular-halicore open closed --class not_a_bug` on a bug whose RCA proved no defect ever existed FAILED: the close routed to the billable completion verifier, which synthesized the criterion "bug is actually resolved: the reported defect no longer reproduces" and marked it unmet — correctly noting "no code change was made" and "the premise of the criterion (that a real defect existed and was resolved) is itself refuted by the RCA". A truthful not_a_bug close is thus impossible without --force whenever there is no replacement ticket to link.

## Mechanism
close_disposition.verdict() mints a deterministic disposition verdict only from find_replacement() (a live duplicates/supersedes link). not_a_bug is in DISPOSITION_CLASSES but inherently names no replacement, so verdict() returns None and the close falls through to full completion verification — which asks the wrong question for this class. The historical scoping comment (close_precheck.py ~:154) already recognizes "not_a_bug asserts there is no defect", but only exempted it from the duplicate-link REQUIREMENT, leaving it on the completion-verification path. escalated without a live replacement has the same fall-through shape (it "may point outside the tracker").

## Fix (stacked on Gerrit 1794, ticket fc20 — reuse its machinery verbatim)
Make not_a_bug a REASON-REQUIRED class exactly like obsolete/wontfix: add it to close_disposition.REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES so (a) txn.close_class_refusal demands --reason=<text> (the RCA summary / pointer to the RCA comment), (b) verdict() mints the deterministic (class, close_reason) attestation with no replacement and no LLM, (c) decorate_manifest signs the disposition line, (d) the --reason-without---force admission in transition.py extends to it. Decide escalated deliberately: either reason-required the same way (reason = where it went), or keep replacement-preferred with reason fallback — document the choice. not_a_bug stays bug-only (NOT added to ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES non-bug vocabulary).

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] A bug close --class not_a_bug --reason "<why no defect>" (no --force, no replacement link) closes without invoking the billable completion verifier and mints a SIGNED disposition attestation carrying class+reason (store-event + manifest tests).
- [x] not_a_bug without --reason is refused at write time naming the requirement (gate-independent, txn.close_class_refusal test).
- [x] escalated's no-replacement path has an explicit, tested disposition (reason-required or documented fall-through — no silent completion-verifier routing).
- [x] 738a drift-guard and 1794's administrative-close suite stay green; docs (ticket-model.md, cli-reference) updated.
- [x] make lint / make typecheck clean; lands via Gerrit (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1).
